description: Take screenshots of a web page — the workspace's own site, usually — with a headless browser, as a desktop (1440×900 at 2×) and/or a mobile (390×844 at 3×) capture, and save them to the media library as images: shots for create_video, or pictures for a post. Each device costs 2 credits; when the month's credits cover fewer devices than asked, it captures what they cover and says so, and once they are spent it is refused with the balance — tell the user, do not retry. The server fetches whatever public https address is given, so point it only at pages the user named; private and internal addresses are refused. fullPage captures the whole page (as a JPEG) rather than the first screen (PNG). Waits up to `wait` seconds (default 40) for the capture; a page that takes longer is finished with get_video.

fullPage.description: The whole page rather than the first screen (default false)

url.description: The page to capture, e.g. https://example.com/

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the capture (default 40)

workspaceId.description: Which workspace to act in — an id from list_workspaces. Optional with a single workspace; REQUIRED once there are several, where guessing would mean posting one client's content to another client's accounts. Ask the user which one before publishing.

name: capture_screenshot
title: Screenshot a website
